cards.example_en: Many students look up to the coach.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生尊敬这位教练。

cards.example_en: Do not lose heart after one low score.
cards.example_zh: 不要一次低分就灰心。

cards.example_en: Do not lose sight of the main idea.
cards.example_zh: 不要忽略掉主旨。

cards.example_en: Graduates sometimes lose touch with classmates.
cards.example_zh: 毕业生有时和同学断了联系。

cards.example_en: You must make a choice before noon.
cards.example_zh: 你必须在中午前做出选择。

cards.example_en: We need to make a decision before Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要在星期五前做决定。

cards.example_en: A kind word can make a difference.
cards.example_zh: 一句善意的话也能有影响。

cards.example_en: Few students make a fortune at a school fair.
cards.example_zh: 很少有学生在校园义卖上发一笔财。

cards.example_en: He can make a living by teaching music.
cards.example_zh: 他可以靠教音乐谋生。

cards.example_en: Anyone can make a mistake on a new paper.
cards.example_zh: 任何人在新试卷上都可能犯一个错误。

cards.example_en: Let us make a plan for the trip.
cards.example_zh: 我们来为旅行制定计划。

cards.example_en: Do not make a promise you cannot keep.
cards.example_zh: 不要作出自己守不住的承诺。

cards.example_en: Please make an effort to arrive early.
cards.example_zh: 请努力早一点到。

cards.example_en: The crowd will make for the main exit.
cards.example_zh: 人群将向主出口走去。

cards.example_en: She wants to make money for a new bike.
cards.example_zh: 她想赚钱买一辆新自行车。

cards.example_en: I cannot make out this handwriting.
cards.example_zh: 我辨认不出这笔字。

cards.example_en: You will make progress if you practise.
cards.example_zh: 如果练习，你就会取得进步。

cards.example_en: That answer does not make sense.
cards.example_zh: 那个答案说不通。

cards.example_en: Make the most of the reading week.
cards.example_zh: 尽量利用这个阅读周。

cards.example_en: Do not make up a story to hide a mistake.
cards.example_zh: 别编故事来掩盖错误。

cards.example_en: An apology can make up for the delay.
cards.example_zh: 一句道歉可以弥补这次耽搁。

cards.example_en: Make use of the sample essays.
cards.example_zh: 加以使用这些范文。

cards.example_en: A few parents object to the late meeting.
cards.example_zh: 有几位家长反对这场晚间会议。

cards.example_en: In the novel, the old sailor will pass away at dawn.
cards.example_zh: 小说里，老水手将在黎明去世。

cards.example_en: Our class will pay a visit to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们班将去拜访博物馆。

cards.example_en: Pay attention to the last example.
cards.example_zh: 注意最后一个例子。

cards.example_en: I will pay for the tickets.
cards.example_zh: 票钱我来付。

cards.example_en: Daily practice will pay off.
cards.example_zh: 每天练习会得到回报。

cards.example_en: Can you pick out the topic sentence?
cards.example_zh: 你能挑选出主题句吗？

cards.example_en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 请把地上的纸捡起来。

cards.example_en: Clubs play a part in school life.
cards.example_zh: 社团在校园生活中起一份作用。

cards.example_en: Sleep can play a role in memory.
cards.example_zh: 睡眠可以在记忆中起作用。

cards.example_en: Can you point out the error?
cards.example_zh: 你能指出这个错误吗？

cards.example_en: We prepare for the exam every evening.
cards.example_zh: 我们每天晚上着手准备考试。

cards.example_en: A hat can protect you from the noon sun.
cards.example_zh: 帽子可以保护你免受正午的太阳晒。

cards.example_en: The budget must provide for lab costs.
cards.example_zh: 预算必须预备实验费用。

cards.example_en: Put aside your phone during the lecture.
cards.example_zh: 讲座期间暂时放下手机。

cards.example_en: She will put forward a new club rule.
cards.example_zh: 她将提出一条新的社团规则。

cards.example_en: We may put off the picnic if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能推迟野餐。

cards.example_en: Put out the fire before you leave camp.
cards.example_zh: 离开营地前把火熄灭。

cards.example_en: I cannot put up with the chemical smell.
cards.example_zh: 我无法忍受这种化学气味。

cards.example_en: This pronoun can refer to the whole class.
cards.example_zh: 这个代词可以指全班。

cards.example_en: Do not rely on a single source.
cards.example_zh: 不要只信赖一个来源。

cards.example_en: This song can remind me of spring.
cards.example_zh: 这首歌能使我想起春天。

cards.example_en: The error may result from haste.
cards.example_zh: 这个错误可能由匆忙导致。

cards.example_en: Haste can result in a costly error.
cards.example_zh: 匆忙可能导致代价很大的错误。

cards.example_en: You may run into your coach at the station.
cards.example_zh: 你可能在车站偶遇教练。
